cards.answer: Sett is a fighter/tank who pressures enemies with alternating punches and pulls. He converts damage taken into a shield and an area strike with a true-damage center; his build focus is AD and health. Keep your distance and sidestep Haymaker's center.
cards.counterplay: Keep your distance and sidestep Haymaker's center.

cards.answer: Pit Grit alternates left and right punches; the right punch is faster and deals bonus physical damage. Sett gains more health regeneration as his missing health increases.
cards.counterplay: Avoid extended punch trades and account for his regeneration when he retreats.

citations.quote: Sett's basic attacks alternate between his Left Punch and a Right Punch. His Right Punch attacks more quickly with bonus range and deals bonus physical damage.

cards.answer: Knuckle Down empowers Sett's next two basic attacks with bonus range and bonus physical damage based on the target's maximum health. It resets his basic attack timer and briefly grants movement speed toward enemy champions.
cards.counterplay: Create distance when he advances and avoid trading into his empowered punches.

cards.answer: Haymaker stores damage taken as Grit, which fades after a delay. Casting consumes his stored Grit for a decaying shield and an area strike whose damage increases with Grit spent. The center deals true damage; the sides deal physical damage.
cards.counterplay: Sidestep the center and consider disengaging while his shield and stored Grit fade.

cards.answer: Facebreaker pulls enemies from in front of and behind Sett, dealing physical damage and slowing them. If it catches enemies on opposite sides, the enemies hit are also stunned; minions can help satisfy this condition.
cards.counterplay: Avoid lining up across Sett from your allies or minions.

cards.answer: The Show Stopper suppresses an enemy champion and carries them forward into a slam that deals physical damage and slows nearby enemies. Its damage increases with the carried target's bonus health, and enemies farther from the epicenter take less damage. Sett has displacement immunity during the carry.
cards.counterplay: Spread away from the landing area and avoid giving him a path to carry a durable ally into your team.
